newsitem.title: USA: Police storm possible Cunanan siege site.
newsitem.headline: Police storm possible Cunanan siege site.

text.p: Police hunting Andrew Cunanan, suspected in the killing of Italian designer Gianni Versace, stormed a houseboat in Miami Beach on Wednesday night where an unidentified man had barricaded himself, TV images showed.
Police moved onto the houseboat minutes after several detonations were heard at the scene.
Six black-clad SWAT officers moved in single file onto the houseboat, crouching behind shields, the images showed.
The footage was broadcast several minutes after the officers went in. No further detonations were heard.
It was not clear if they had arrested anyone.
